note: The doctor. Pale coat and a bag, which is the whole vocabulary of the trade anywhere.
The coat is drawn as a second, slightly larger torso rather than by recolouring the shirt, because it has to read as a garment over a person — the collar and the hem below the belt are what say coat.

parts.note: the coat over the chest, a shade proud of the body so the two do not fight for the same pixels
and its skirt, below the belt, which is what makes it a coat and not a shirt

the bag, carried at the side: dark, square, and nothing else in a village has one. Held close in, because a footprint is measured off the parts — a bag at arm's length made the doctor nearly twice as deep as anybody else and he blocked a doorway sideways
